items.name: sims4-animation
items.status: Verified Shadowheart body adapter; other rigs require validation
items.description: Apply a selected TS4 animation to an asset using the installed binary codec and verified rig adapter. Save a new Blender Action and working file; preserve the source.
items.prompt:
Work in /data/ai/projects/images. Use sims4-animation.

Apply [CLIP_NAME_OR_RESOURCE_KEY] from [ANIMATION_PACKAGE_OR_CLIP_PATH] to [ASSET_PATH]. Preserve the asset's appearance, clothing and original files. Save the imported source Action and retargeted Action in a new versioned .blend.

Use the installed TS4 codec and fixed retargeting adapter on the separate 4 GiB worker. For Shadowheart, use the verified adult-female TS4 to MHX body adapter. For another rig, verify or build its mapping before applying motion; do not silently use Shadowheart's profile. Check source/rest-pose compatibility, root motion, saved/reopened animation and visible motion. Report unmapped tracks and contact/clothing limitations. Ask in ordinary chat if the clip selection is missing.
items.limits: Verified neutral head-turn application to Shadowheart MHX. Body rotations and optional scaled root motion only; individual package clips need review. Finger/face/contact/prop/garment corrections and other rigs are not qualified.

items.name: Apply an animation and capture a short clip
items.status: Supported routes with per-asset video validation
items.description: Apply a selected animation to an existing asset, then render a short MP4 from the resulting Action. Includes TS4 retargeting when needed.
items.prompt:
Work in /data/ai/projects/images. Use sims4-animation for TS4 input and asset-image-clip-capture for rendering.

Apply [ANIMATION_NAME_OR_RESOURCE_KEY] from [ANIMATION_SOURCE_PATH] to [ASSET_PATH], then capture a short MP4 of the resulting animation. Aim for 1–2 seconds with [CAMERA_VIEW] framing. Preserve the asset's appearance, clothing and source files.

If the asset already has the requested compatible Blender Action, reuse it. Otherwise decode/import the selected motion and verify the target rig mapping. Use the verified Shadowheart adapter only for a matching MHX rig; establish a separate adapter for other rigs. Save a new working .blend and validate the Action after reopening.

Prepare and capture through the native dispatcher and separate 4 GiB worker. Use the Action's actual FPS and a bounded frame range, maintaining timing. Start with small preview settings and fit resolution, samples and frame count within the worker's frame/pixel/time budgets; do not assume character video is already qualified. Render only after preparation passes. Verify the actual MP4 duration, frame count, visible motion, framing and clothing; return the clip, working file and any limitations. Reconcile uncertain jobs instead of resubmitting. If the animation selection is ambiguous, ask in ordinary chat before choosing.
items.limits: A prompt does not launch a job. TS4 adapter currently targets Shadowheart body controls; other rigs and each clip need validation. Short character-video quality/runtime require actual checks. No automatic contact, finger/face or clothing-fit correction.
items.source: Installed sims4-animation + asset-image-clip-capture; TS4 retarget and video-capture references

items.name: esp32-development
items.status: Real board build, flash, serial ping/pong and restore verified
items.description: Develop applications for the server-connected ESP32-DIV v2, compile firmware, flash approved builds and inspect serial responses through the native hardware worker.
items.prompt:
Work in /data/ai/projects/llm/esp32. Use esp32-development.

Develop [APPLICATION_OR_TOOL] for my enrolled ESP32-DIV v2 using [PERIPHERALS_OR_INTERFACES]. Ask for any essential behavior, display or wiring details. Preserve existing source and firmware. Use the verified S3 profile with a4MB firmware layout on16MB physical flash; leave PSRAM disabled until separately qualified and confirm hardware pins from the manufacturer sources.

Build with the isolated native worker and review compiler results. Show me what the firmware changes and ask before flashing unless I have explicitly authorized this build. When approved, back up the complete existing firmware, flash only the pinned build to esp32-div-v2, and verify it. Test [EXPECTED_SERIAL_BEHAVIOR] through bounded serial commands/monitoring; return source, firmware, logs, backup ID and any missing hardware checks. Keep unrelated server services unchanged.
items.limits: Native watoom_esp32 is scoped to the ESP32 project and explicitly enrolled USB identity. Generic Arduino SDK applications are supported; stock DIV firmware patches/libraries are separate. Build success does not prove hardware behavior. Flashing resets the device and changes its running firmware. The initial profile addresses4MB and disables the detected8MB PSRAM; enabling OPI PSRAM caused startup watchdog resets with this SDK.
